questions.prompt: What is the primary execution depth for this NODE lane goal?
questions.description: Lane ownership is fixed (template/files/node/** except node/saas/**). Choose how deep the first /goal execution should go.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Validate the three Node-oriented samples, fix defects found in owned paths only, and emit COORD handoffs for any contract gaps. No dep modernization unless a gate fails.

options.description: Also refresh package.json.jinja pins/tooling inside owned paths when safe (still no lockfile hand-edits).

questions.prompt: If tradeoffs force ordering, which non-SaaS surfaces get attention first?
questions.description: All remain in lane ownership. Priority only affects fix order when time is limited. Existing verification targets: docs-fumadocs, docs-docusaurus, mcp-typescript.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Docs frameworks (Fumadocs then Docusaurus), then TypeScript MCP, then Fastify api-node, then shared-config/workspace/release fragments.

questions.prompt: How should NODE treat monorepo workspace Jinja that still lists the saas package path?
questions.description: pnpm-workspace.yaml.jinja currently includes a saas entry. SAAS lane owns template/files/node/saas/** content. NODE owns workspace coherence for non-SaaS packages.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep the saas workspace entry if required for monorepo renders, but never edit node/saas/**. If the entry is wrong or should be conditional on answers, emit a COORD handoff rather than inventing answer keys.
